== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Fiends are chaotic entities warped by the Void that exist to consume entire worlds. They are characterized by their ability to distort reality, manipulate gravity, and manifest nonsensical environments such as landscapes of fleshy trees. These creatures range significantly in power and [[scale]], from smaller entities to massive, country-sized beasts that resemble living islands with countless limbs. Some Fiends are large enough to swallow planets or consume shards of existence itself. Fiends are categorized by a classification system based on the level of threat they pose. Lower-level threats, such as Class Four Fiends, can be resisted by strong mortals, while Class Three Fiends require entire groups of [[Abidan]] to combat. Higher-tier entities, like Class Two Fiends, are massive enough to bite into planets. Some individuals have even attempted to bind Fiends to serve their own purposes, though these beings often remain defiant or exert pressure on their hosts. While some view them as mere monsters, they are fundamentally driven by a [[hunger]] to devour existence.}}
